lines.en: I row along the river, slow and calm.
My long neck reaches out straight.
I glide past the reeds.
I come ashore with steady steps.
I wade slowly through the shallows.
I sway my body forward.
I swim half a turn of the bend.
Ripples spread behind me.

lines.zh: 我低头理了理胸前羽毛。
lines.en: I dip my head to smooth my breast feathers.
I step by step toward the water.
I lift my wings slightly.
I swim across a patch of reflection.
I stop mid-river and drift.
I turn slowly toward the bank.
I tread wet mud, leaving prints.
I glide with the current.
I float on the water, steady.
My reflection is quieter than I am.

lines.zh: 我的颈子贴着背，突然抬起来。
lines.en: My neck rests on my back, then lifts all at once.
I preen slowly.
The river is smooth as a mirror.
I wait for something on the surface.

lines.zh: 河流里，我跟着你手里的鱼。
lines.en: On the river I follow the fish in your hand.
The wind rattles the reeds.
I hold still, drifting with the waves.
Ducks swim past in the distance.
I float with my neck curved like a question.
The water mirrors the sky.
I rest in the river bend.
I look down at my own shadow.
You stand on the bank, silent.

lines.zh: 我的黑喙对着你，脖子弯成问号。
lines.en: My black bill points at you, neck curved like a question mark.
You are on the bank; I am mid-river.
Your shadow falls on the river.
I glance at you and swim off.
I raise my neck to look taller.
When you come close, I turn to midstream.
I'm not afraid; only distant.
I spread my wings, then close them.
This water is mine to swim.
I jerk my neck back.
A few white feathers fall to the water.
I row backward away.
This pain is no matter.

lines.zh: 我的长颈弯下来，护住翅膀。
lines.en: My long neck curls down to shield my wing.

lines.zh: 河面的倒影里，我的脖子很白。
lines.en: In the river's reflection my neck is very white.

lines.zh: 血丝从我翅下散开，我往深处游。
lines.en: Blood threads from under my wing as I swim deeper.
I can still swim.
I remember your shape.
I swim into the reeds.
That smells of fish.
I row over slowly.
Set it down on the bank.
I stretch my neck to check.
This smells better than weeds.
I come a little closer, careful.
On the river I glide steady.

lines.zh: 我低头啄食，眼睛还盯着你的手。
lines.en: I peck at the food, eyes still on your hand.

lines.zh: 你撒的食太少，我的喙还没热。
lines.en: You scattered too little; my bill has barely touched it.
You may come half a step closer.
You touched me and the water splashed.
My body is light in water.
I open a little distance.
Your hand hit my wing.
I turn out toward midstream.
There's little sound in water.
I was pushed a little off course.

lines.zh: 水珠从我翼尖甩到你身上。
lines.en: Drops fly from my wingtips onto you.
The bank mud is slippery.
I swim back to my place.
Another white bird swims over.
Our necks curve together.
We swim side by side on the water.
Its feathers are brighter than mine.
The reeds are good for a nest.

lines.zh: 我们一起低头整理羽毛。
lines.en: We dip our heads and preen together.
Our reflections merge into one.
The current brings us close.
Sunset falls on both our backs.
Before dark, we come ashore together.
I stretch my neck and take it.
I dip for what's sunk below.

lines.zh: 我用喙夹了两次，才夹稳。
lines.en: It slips twice before my bill holds it.
I carry it back to the bank.
I set it on the grass.
This is enough for a meal.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，脖子被坠得低下。
lines.en: I lift it, and my neck sags under the weight.

lines.zh: 我的长颈一伸，就够到水底。
lines.en: One stretch of my long neck reaches the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，把那东西咽下去。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 我叼着那东西，甩掉上面的水草。
lines.en: I hold it in my bill and shake the weeds off.
There's a small stir over there.
I see it, under the surface.
I row slowly over there.
That looks edible.

lines.zh: 河面上的白影，跟着你的鱼。
lines.en: The white shape follows your fish.
I stretch my neck further.
Fine, that one.
Not far; I'll swim over.

lines.zh: 我开始动了，河面的倒影跟着。
lines.en: I start to move; my reflection follows on the river.
I head for that patch of surface.
I approach slowly, lightly.
The ripples give me away.
I pause and look again.
It surfaced to breathe.

lines.zh: 我伸着长颈，从芦苇边划过去。
lines.en: Neck stretched, I glide past the reeds.
I bend my neck down.
Just a little distance.
The reeds hide my shadow.

lines.zh: 我贴着芦苇滑过去，水面很静。
lines.en: I slide along the reeds; the water stays still.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一弯，就是个问号。
lines.en: My neck bends into a question mark.

lines.zh: 我的喙夹住它，往岸上拖。
lines.en: My bill clamps on and drags it ashore.
I slap the water with a wing.
I stretch my neck to peck.
This strength is only for catching food.
One shake and it lets go.
Water splashes over me.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，把头往水下压。
lines.en: I bite down and force my head underwater.
I withdraw and smooth my feathers.

lines.zh: 它已经不动了，水也静了。
lines.en: It has stopped moving, and the water is still.
I swim back to midstream.
I swim out of the reeds.
I settle on the river, lightly.
A swan, gliding in the bend.

lines.zh: 我的白羽在暗水里很显眼。
lines.en: My white feathers stand out in the dark water.
I glide slowly along the river.
I drifted down from upstream.
The river surface gives one soft ripple.
I lift my head and look about.
The river runs slow here.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇丛里滑出，水纹散开。
lines.en: I glide out of the reeds, ripples spreading.

lines.zh: 火焰舔到我的羽毛，卷了边。
lines.en: Flame licks my feathers and they curl.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下，砸在水面上。
lines.en: I fall from the air onto the water.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的羽毛，我沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my plumage and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把整片水面掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole surface.

lines.zh: 箭穿过羽翼，白羽落了一地。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my wing, and white feathers fall.

lines.zh: 紫光晃过，我的颈子转了半圈。
lines.en: Violet light flashes past, and my neck twists half around.
Hungry enough that my neck sags.

lines.zh: 雷打在河面上，我整只都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and numbs me whole.
No water here; I can't float.
